Coffee and drinks

Google reviews mention the freddo cappuccino 3 times, the flat white, espresso tonic, americano and matcha 2 times each, and the barista 4 times.

Snacks

Snacks are mentioned 3 times and the wrap 2 times in the reviews. The counter photo shows folded flatbreads on a wooden board.

Open from 06:00
